changes.change: Nine country CSVs stacked into one schema
changes.rule: sha256 of each CSV checked against the package MANIFEST.json before use; every row kept
changes.rationale: One table across the packages; the packages themselves are never edited

changes.rule: unit_key = ISO3 + ':' + stable_id
changes.rationale: Distinct keys across sources while keeping the package identifier (also the atlas region id)

changes.rule: Rice, paddy -> rice_paddy; Rice, milled -> rice_milled; Rice, brown -> rice_brown; Maize, Wheat, Soybean, Sorghum, Cassava -> lowercase codes; every other product -> slug of its name; product name retained
changes.rationale: Milled and paddy rice stay apart; other products keep their published name

changes.rule: season_std replaces 'Summer Rice' with 'Autumn Rice' (Northern and Southern); season_name keeps the label as published
changes.rationale: The calendar gives both labels identical months and they never share a unit-year; the 24 September analysis made the same join

changes.rule: area_ha = area_planted_ha where yield_basis is planted (356536 rows) or area_harvested_ha where harvested (100221); where yield_basis is missing whichever area exists (101 rows) with area_basis recorded
changes.rationale: One area column with its basis stated; yields on different bases are not comparable and the column says which

changes.rule: complete = area complete for the basis AND production complete; unknown where either is blank
changes.rationale: One flag for 'every constituent unit reported'; incomplete sums are lower bounds

changes.rule: harvest_year = year + harvest_year_offset from the season calendar: +1 for India 'Whole Year' (56286 rows) and the Japanese (1973) and Korean (42) winter seasons; 0 elsewhere
changes.rationale: The published year is a sowing-year label for those seasons; the ENSO windows need the harvest year

changes.rule: yield_mt_ha used as is (t/ha); asserted equal to production/area to 1e-6 where positive
changes.rationale: The package already recomputed yield from summed numerators and denominators

changes.rule: see source_corrections: East Java 2017 paddy area 13060464 -> 2285232 ha, yield 1.0 -> 5.715 t/ha; observation marked corrected=1
changes.rationale: A verified source error (BPS Table 2.17); the 24 September analysis and the atlas apply the same correction

changes.change: Corrections made by the packagers before delivery
changes.rule: Indonesia: zero-filled template rows for provinces before they existed dropped (14740), zero production with positive area set to missing (513), 2024 zero placeholders dropped, 2023 maize duplicate definition resolved, rice wetland/dryland components kept beside the total; Korea: polished wheat and rye duplicates left out, radish label change joined, field and greenhouse vegetables kept separate, 204 zero-production rows set to missing; all countries: late_reporting rows removed
changes.rationale: Documented in 4_ag/v0.1/README.md and 4_ag/v0.2/README.md; not redone here

changes.rule: item codes 56 maize, 27 rice (paddy), 15 wheat, 236 soya beans, 83 sorghum, 125 cassava fresh; elements 5312 area harvested, 5510 production, 5412 yield
changes.rationale: The six staples of the project from a 545 MB file

changes.rule: yield converted from kg/ha (the unit stated in the file) to t/ha
changes.rationale: One yield unit across sources

changes.rule: M49 code -> ISO3 through pycountry; 42 of 235 areas dropped: regional aggregates, the China aggregate (351; China mainland 41 kept), dissolved states (USSR, Czechoslovakia, Yugoslav SFR, Ethiopia PDR, Sudan former, Belgium-Luxembourg, Serbia and Montenegro)
changes.rationale: Only current states with an ISO3 code enter; aggregates would double count

changes.rule: rows with a blank Value not kept; FAOSTAT flags (A official E estimated I imputed X international M missing) retained per element
changes.rationale: Missing is missing; the flag says how the kept values were obtained

changes.rule: harvest_year = FAOSTAT year (the calendar year of the bulk of the harvest); season 'annual'; no months
changes.rationale: FAOSTAT's own convention; months come from the calendar sources

changes.rule: 309 rows (0.8 percent) where the published yield differs from production/area by more than 1 percent kept as published and flagged error in QC
changes.rationale: FAOSTAT computes yield from unrounded inputs or different vintages; the fits exclude them

changes.rule: six released .dta panels read in place; the wheat panel split by its crop column into wheat_spring and wheat_winter before deduplicating units (3510 of 3540 spring units also appear as winter units)
changes.rationale: The replication package's own structure; the panels are never written

changes.rule: unit_key = iso:adm1_id:adm2_id after hultgren_repro.gridagg.normalize_keys (India and Zambia keyed by admin names); uid kept
changes.rationale: The portable key that joins the package shapefile; uid has no meaning outside the panel

changes.rule: a polygon with two or three uids (17 maize polygons in Nicaragua; 77 rice in Sri Lanka and Vietnam) is one unit with that many seasons; seasons labelled planted_m<month> (188 series, 3725 rows), undated where the panel has no dates (38 series)
changes.rationale: Keeps (unit, season) distinct without inventing season names the source does not have

changes.rule: kg/ha -> t/ha
changes.rationale: One yield unit across sources

changes.rule: harvest_year = label + 1 when the season's harvest month is June or earlier (the panel labels India by the July-June agricultural year); 12366 rows shifted; all Indian rows later excluded (see M1)
changes.rationale: The authors' collapse_clim.do convention; documented by hultgren_repro.gridagg

changes.rule: planting and harvest months from median_plant_date and median_harvest_date by the authors' day-of-year cutoffs; a season starting and ending in the same month becomes a twelve-month season (the authors' rule)
changes.rationale: The panel's own seasons; the calendar sources may later replace them (C1)

changes.rule: cropped_ha carried as area_weight_ha (a per-unit constant) and not as annual area; area_ha and production_t left empty
changes.rationale: The released panels have no annual area or production

changes.rule: United States maize (57787 rows), soybean (32140) and sorghum (4756) county yields 2009-2025 from Hultgren/3_data/derived/*_extended_panel.parquet, yield_src = 'nass'; 94683 rows
changes.rationale: Brings the US series to the present on the same units

changes.rule: crop code 'rice' with no paddy/milled basis; the merge's ratio against FAOSTAT documents milled rice in India (0.64) and brown rice in Japan (0.80)
changes.rationale: The package does not say; the ratio is the evidence

changes.rule: panel rows with a missing yield not kept
changes.rationale: Only observed yields enter

changes.change: Season months replaced by ranked calendar sources
changes.rule: for 13877 of 56748 keys with source-native months the assigned planting or harvest month differs (531727 observation rows); 5260 keys (150030 rows) with no months are newly dated; 1060 keys moved by more than a month, all but 14 by RiceAtlas; plant_month_native and harvest_month_native keep the source months; harvest_year_offset is never changed
changes.rationale: The user's ranking of 26 September 2026 (Hultgren-repository calendars first; RiceAtlas; FAO/GIEWS); see notes/merged_panel.md

changes.rule: proper season names (aman boro aus kharif rabi maha yala) match by name whatever the months; generic labels (wet dry main off summer winter spring autumn) by nearest planting month within three months; RiceAtlas labels Thailand's May-planted main season 'Dry'
changes.rationale: Bangladesh's HarvestStat months start aman in March; RiceAtlas's Thai labels are swapped against the months

changes.rule: Rice 1/2/3 and Maize 1/2 translated with the archive README (Bangladesh Rice 1 boro 2 aman 3 aus; Sri Lanka 1 maha 2 yala; Thailand 1 wet 2 dry)
changes.rationale: GEOGLAM numbers seasons by production rank

changes.change: Hultgren India excluded from the stacked panel
changes.rule: all tier-2 rows with iso3 IND left out of yield_panel (they stay in tier2_gmfd.parquet and in the tier-2 versus FAOSTAT comparison)
changes.rationale: User decision of 26 September 2026: India is HarvestStat only because its stable groups merge the districts that split

changes.rule: for each country, crop family and harvest year the rows of the lowest-numbered tier with a yield are primary (HarvestStat 1, Hultgren 2, FAOSTAT 3); rice codes and wheat codes pooled into families for this rule only
changes.rationale: Follow a series across tiers without counting a year twice

changes.rule: tier-2 rows of a country-crop whose area-weighted national yield is above 3 or below 1/3 of FAOSTAT's: Zambia, all five crops (ratios 2400 to 12000)
changes.rationale: A units error in the released Zambian panel; rows kept and flagged

changes.rule: area_basis missing -> 'unknown'; complete -> 0/1/NULL; corrected -> 0/1; integer series_id assigned in a fixed sort; representative point per unit from the source geometry
changes.rationale: SQLite types and stable identifiers

changes.rule: fourteen checks written to qc_flags; no value altered; 19365 observations carry an error (15707 primary staple)
changes.rationale: Exclusion is a fit-time decision; see notes/qc.md

corrections.derived_fields: yield_mt_ha recomputed as production_mt / area (5.715 t/ha); production_mt 13060464 unchanged
